item.tib: rtsa sgrab las chog kha tshar las bla ma mchod pa'i bskang bshags
item.coloph: ces bskang (skong) bshags nyon mongs dug 'joms zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang gzhan kun gyis phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig dang / sdom pa gsum gyi chag nyams bskang phyir du/ sbas yul yol mo gangs ra ru/ khyung dkar ru'i sprang 'khyams grub ming 'bod pas gang dran smras pas bkra shis su gyur cig/
